MongoDB Cheat Sheet

Quick reference for MongoDB commands, CRUD operations, queries, and Mongoose.

1. Start MongoDB Shell


mongosh

mongosh "mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017"

2. Database Commands


// Show all databases
show dbs

// Switch to or create a database
use myDatabase

// Show current database
db

// Delete the current database
db.dropDatabase()

A database is generally created on disk when you first store data in it, rather than simply when you run use.

3. Collection Commands


// Show collections
show collections

// Create a collection
db.createCollection("users")

// Delete a collection
db.users.drop()

4. Insert Documents


// Insert one document
db.users.insertOne({
    name: "Tushar",
    age: 24,
    city: "Chandigarh"
})

// Insert multiple documents
db.users.insertMany([
    { name: "Aman", age: 22 },
    { name: "Rahul", age: 25 }
])

5. Find Documents


// Find all documents
db.users.find()

// Find one document
db.users.findOne({ name: "Tushar" })

// Filter documents
db.users.find({ age: 24 })

// Select specific fields
db.users.find(
    {},
    { name: 1, age: 1, _id: 0 }
)

// Sort ascending
db.users.find().sort({ age: 1 })

// Sort descending
db.users.find().sort({ age: -1 })

// Limit results
db.users.find().limit(5)

// Skip documents
db.users.find().skip(5)

6. Query Operators


// Greater than
db.users.find({ age: { $gt: 20 } })

// Greater than or equal
db.users.find({ age: { $gte: 20 } })

// Less than
db.users.find({ age: { $lt: 30 } })

// Less than or equal
db.users.find({ age: { $lte: 30 } })

// Not equal
db.users.find({ age: { $ne: 24 } })

// Match any listed value
db.users.find({
    city: { $in: ["Delhi", "Chandigarh"] }
})

// AND: both conditions must match
db.users.find({
    age: { $gte: 18 },
    city: "Chandigarh"
})

// OR: either condition can match
db.users.find({
    $or: [
        { age: 18 },
        { city: "Delhi" }
    ]
})

7. Update Documents


// Update one document
db.users.updateOne(
    { name: "Tushar" },
    { $set: { age: 25 } }
)

// Update multiple documents
db.users.updateMany(
    { city: "Delhi" },
    { $set: { city: "New Delhi" } }
)

// Increment a number
db.users.updateOne(
    { name: "Tushar" },
    { $inc: { age: 1 } }
)

// Remove a field
db.users.updateOne(
    { name: "Tushar" },
    { $unset: { city: "" } }
)

8. Delete Documents


// Delete one matching document
db.users.deleteOne({ name: "Tushar" })

// Delete all matching documents
db.users.deleteMany({ age: { $lt: 18 } })

// Delete all documents in a collection
db.users.deleteMany({})

Be careful with delete operations, especially when using an empty filter such as deleteMany({}).

9. Count and Distinct


// Count all documents
db.users.countDocuments({})

// Count matching documents
db.users.countDocuments({ age: 24 })

// Get distinct cities
db.users.distinct("city")

10. Aggregation


// Group users by city
db.users.aggregate([
    {
        $group: {
            _id: "$city",
            totalUsers: { $sum: 1 }
        }
    }
])

// Filter, then group
db.users.aggregate([
    { $match: { age: { $gte: 18 } } },
    {
        $group: {
            _id: "$city",
            averageAge: { $avg: "$age" }
        }
    }
])

// Sort aggregation results
db.users.aggregate([
    { $sort: { age: -1 } }
])

11. Indexes


// Create ascending index
db.users.createIndex({ name: 1 })

// Create descending index
db.users.createIndex({ age: -1 })

// List indexes
db.users.getIndexes()

// Drop an index by name
db.users.dropIndex("name_1")

12. Mongoose Setup


// Install Mongoose in your Node.js project
npm install mongoose

13. Connect Using Mongoose


const mongoose = require("mongoose");

mongoose.connect("mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/myDatabase")
    .then(() => console.log("MongoDB connected"))
    .catch(error => console.error(error));

Keep database credentials in environment variables if your application uses a password or a hosted database.

14. Create a Mongoose Schema and Model


const mongoose = require("mongoose");

const userSchema = new mongoose.Schema({
    name: {
        type: String,
        required: true
    },
    age: {
        type: Number,
        min: 0
    },
    email: {
        type: String,
        unique: true
    }
});

const User = mongoose.model("User", userSchema);

15. Mongoose CRUD Operations


// Create
const user = await User.create({
    name: "Tushar",
    age: 24
});

// Read all
const users = await User.find();

// Read one
const foundUser = await User.findOne({
    name: "Tushar"
});

// Find by ID
const userById = await User.findById(userId);

// Update
await User.updateOne(
    { name: "Tushar" },
    { $set: { age: 25 } }
);

// Find and update
const updatedUser = await User.findByIdAndUpdate(
    userId,
    { age: 25 },
    { returnDocument: "after", runValidators: true }
);

// Delete
await User.deleteOne({ name: "Tushar" });

16. MongoDB Connection String


// Local database
mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/myDatabase

// Example environment variable
MONGODB_URI=mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/myDatabase
